name: Multi-Style Carousel
description: A multi-style multi-slide social carousel (5 slides x N aesthetics) where the deliverable is the baked-text image itself - no HyperFrames compose, every headline and label is rendered INSIDE the image. One brand mascot + one benefit arc (hook -> problem -> how -> proof -> CTA) is reshot across several distinct looks (zine / club / swiss / riso / punk / acid / clean DTC) so the same campaign can A/B a dozen visual registers from one copy deck. The discipline that makes it cohere and stay cheap: a cover-first checkpoint (generate ONE cover per style, user reviews all covers, THEN fill the rest), a dual-ref cohesion rule (--ref mascot --ref {style}-01 on every fill slide so each 5-slide set inherits its cover's paper/light/grade), a reusable per-style JSON STYLE+QUALITY block where only scene.subject + composition.ui_elements vary per slide, and the mascot-fit rule (a clean cute mascot does NOT survive gritty/grunge styles - redraw it IN the medium). Baked on openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 (the only image model that holds embedded typography), serialized at 1 concurrent with transient-network retries.
referenceNotes: Supply ONE neutral mascot master shot; it is passed as --ref on every gen to lock the character. The approved per-style cover (slide 01) is added as a SECOND --ref on each fill slide of that style, so the 5-slide set inherits its cover's exact paper/light/grade.

slots.description: One-sentence physical description of the brand mascot.
Absolute path to the ONE neutral identity-anchor PNG, passed as --ref on every gen.
The single brand accent hex (e.g. '#FFA630'). Lock to ONE hue; ban any second accent in the AVOID list.
The 5-slide benefit arc: per-slide eyebrow + 1-2 line headline + optional sub-line. hook -> problem -> how -> proof -> CTA.
The N aesthetics to reshoot the arc across (e.g. zine / club / swiss / riso / punk / acid / clean-dtc). One reusable STYLE+QUALITY JSON block each.
A pre-distressed mascot variant ref for grunge/xerox/acid styles (the clean mascot fights distressed registers).

doNotCopyLiterally: Cover-first: generate ONE cover per style, show all covers, get the user's pick BEFORE filling slides 02-05 (catches mascot-fit misses before a full set runs). Pass --ref mascot --ref {style}-01 on every fill slide for cohesion. Lock ONE accent hue per prompt + ban a second accent. For gritty styles, redraw the mascot IN the print medium (or use a distressed variant) - a clean cute mascot does not survive grunge. Serialize on gpt-5.4-image-2 (1 concurrent per key); never edit/delete a prompt file while a background gen-loop reads it.
stackSummary: openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 only ($0.20/image, --size 1080x1350, --concurrency 1) - the sole image model that bakes crisp embedded typography; gemini smudges letterforms. Local ffmpeg hstack for per-style contact sheets. No video/VO/music/render. ~$6.8 for a 6-style x 5-slide set.
